votes.motion: Commissioner Squire motioned to approve the Planning Commission Meeting minutes from December 10, 2020

Commissioner Van Hoff motioned to approve the Special Exception for section 4.2.3.1 as allowed in Section 4.7 of the Suncrest Development Guidelines, as requested by Adam Breen, representing Breen Homes for Lot 27 Oak Vista No. 1 at Suncrest Plat Amendment, Application SUBD-980-2020, based on the finding listed in the power point and subject to the conditions listed in the Staff Report Dated January 5, 2021

Commissioner Ogden motioned to approve the Plat Amendment, as requested by Adam Breen, representing Breen Homes for Lot 27 Oak Vista No. 1 at Suncrest Plat Amendment, Application SUBD-980-2020, based on the finding listed in the power point and subject to the conditions listed in the Staff Report Dated January 5, 2021

Commissioner Player motioned to forward a positive recommendation to the City Council for the Development Agreement as requested by Paxton Guymon, representing Siempre LLC, for Siempre Event Center Development Agreement, Application DA-1106- 2020, based on the findings and subject to the conditions listed in the Staff Report dated January 5, 2021

Commissioner Squire motioned to forward a positive recommendation to the City Council for the Zoning Map Amendment as requested by Draper City for the City initiated Windsor Mill Zoning Map Amendment, Application TEXTMAP-1121-2020, based on the findings and subject to the conditions listed in the staff report dated January 5, 2021

Commissioner Van Hoff motioned to forward a positive recommendation to the City Council for the Land Use Map Amendment as requested by Draper City for the City initiated Windsor Mill Land Use Map Amendment, Application TEXTMAP-1121-2020, based on the findings and subject to the conditions listed in the staff report dated January 5, 2021

Commissioner Ogden motioned to approve forward a positive recommendation to the City Council for the Text Amendment as requested by Draper City for the City initiated Parking Ordinance Changes with the two changes proposed by Commissioner Van Hoff, Application TEXTMAP-1122-2020, based on the findings and subject to the conditions listed in the staff report dated January 4, 2021

Commissioner Van Hoff motioned to approve forward a positive recommendation to the City Council for the Text Amendment as requested by Draper City for the City initiated Land Use Buffer Text Amendment. Application TEXTMAP-1122-2020, based on the findings and subject to the conditions listed in the staff report dated January 4, 2021. And request Staff to look into section 9-23-110 subsection C(2)(c) concerning the five-foot hedgerow versus the eight-foot wall
